authorized_change: User requested new training, then explicitly asked this assistant to create and review labels. These are AI annotations, not human gold.
source: 360 native Wikinews title+lead items: 180 DE and 180 EN; selected before labels using seed from 1500 most-recent published memberships per language.

annotation.annotator: Codex assistant in this chat; exact model serving revision unavailable
annotation.method: Assistant reads every exact input, assigns class and short rationale without candidate predictions; same annotator checks consistency. No consensus or human validation claimed.
annotation.rubric: Main reported outcome for the main affected subject/audience: negative=evidenced harm/loss/deterioration/material risk; positive=evidenced benefit/recovery/improvement; neutral=no clear directional outcome. Factual reporting is not automatically neutral. Exclude substantially ambiguous/mixed targets, missing context or broken extraction.
annotation.reference_label_quality: Provisional single-AI reference annotations; errors and systematic preference biases remain possible.

split: 7-fold StratifiedGroupKFold on language:label, shuffle=True seed20261107: fold0 Test, fold1 Val, other5 Train (approximately71/14/14); group linked DE/EN pages, identical source URLs, normalized duplicates, char4/5-gram TFIDF cosine>=.85. No post-score seed changes. Residual event overlap possible.
training: Train only; Val never opened. Fixed final epoch, no cross-validation or hyperparameter search in this small feasibility pilot. Historical recipes adopted before labels/predictions.

candidates.frozen_news_v3: Clean original MiniLM pinned e8f8c211226b894fcb81acc59f3b34ba3efd5f42, max128, GPU frozen embeddings + balanced C1 logistic head, maxiter2000.
candidates.minilm_fp32_news_v3: New frozen-head initialization, all encoder layers updated on full new Train for3epochs, batch32, AdamW encoder2e-5/head2e-4 weight_decay.01 warmup10%, inverse-class weighted CE, gradientclip1, BF16 autocast FP32master; FP32 serving.
candidates.minilm_bf16_news_v3: Same newly trained MiniLM weights cast to BF16; v2 deployment recipe, not another independent training fit. Uniform chunk-mean inference as selected historical R3.
candidates.linearsvc_news_v3: Independent reconstruction of C1 balanced word/bigram TFIDF min_df1 LinearSVC maxiter2000; fit only new Train without old46-row supplement.
candidates.qwen3_4b: Unchanged pinned local Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 zero-shot prompt1; no training and not the label creator.

evaluation: After all classifier artifacts frozen, each candidate predicts every held-out Test input once; resume only from saved per-item predictions after interruption, never retune after Test. No old test re-evaluation.
metrics: Accuracy, macro-F1, F1 each class, per-language metrics and confusion matrices, mean(DE_macro_F1,EN_macro_F1), warm ms/text, complete artifact bytes. All accuracy/F1 metrics measure agreement with AI annotations, not independent human correctness.
tie_rule: Within0.005 absolute of best balanced-language macro-F1 prefer lower inference_ms_per_text then artifact bytes; descriptive pilot leader only.
latency: Same RTX5060Ti, CPUthreads4, warmup20 calls using separate authored example, batch1, CUDA synchronized, tokenizer/transfers included; model load, network and file persistence excluded. API stopped during measurement to release its Qwen GPU allocation.
tracking: article-sentiment-second-path; phase=wikinews-ai-v3-pilot; data_version/comparable_group/label_source/human_gold=false/deployment_eligible=false tags. Preserve all historical MLflow runs.
release: Separate ignored models/common_data_v3; add explicitly experimental website choices and separate AI-labelled comparison. No automatic production default switch based only on AI-labelled evidence. Original Qwen default retained.
limits: Small single-source title/lead sample, no full-article accuracy claim
Single AI annotator and self-review; AI mistakes and class/target ambiguity
Pretraining contamination and remaining same-event overlap unknown
Native DE/EN, not translations; not numerically comparable to historical test scores
